scientific_integrity: The full palindrome-index characterization used in the derivation is previously published by Barker et al. (2020, Proposition 3); the new claim is the bivariate distribution and exact extrema.
scientific_limitations: Labeled alphabets; palindrome words, not factor palindromes or letter involutions; literature-equivalence risk remains; finite checks are corroborative only.
title: Exact length–universality distribution of palindromic words and shortest-host classification
